title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
金色资质...丑丑鱼之前只是绿色资质，林枫想过会有跨越，但没想到，跨越竟然会如此之大。竟然直接变成了金色资质。“悠~？”【恭喜宿主让美纳斯的愉悦值从70%提升到98%，奖励金坷垃20袋，中级神奇糖果一枚（提升中幅度能量强度），求雨技能光盘。】恰巧此刻。美纳斯也从进化后的余晖反应过来，不可置信的看着水面上倒映着自己的身形。脑子前所未有的清明。进化了？每一只丑丑鱼都知道自己能够进化成为美纳斯。但又清楚，丑丑鱼进化成为美纳斯的概率有多低。大部分丑丑鱼一辈子，可能也就是丑丑鱼了...只有少数可能在某种意外下，成功进化。这就像鲤鱼跃龙门一般梦幻。所以，丑丑鱼从来没想过自己也有一天，能进化成为美纳斯...它还以为林枫刚刚在鱼缸里面的话语是逗它开心的呢。“悠悠~！”（进化啦~！）“是的，你进化了！”进化成为美纳斯后，林枫的常磐之力，已经能很清晰的听懂它话语中表达的意思了。“悠悠...”（好开心~！）似乎有些开心过头了的美纳斯，情不自禁的直接用尾巴缠绕住了林枫的身体，好像要举高高的样子。突如其来的失重感和如蟒蛇缠绕一般的窒息感，让林枫有些不适应的高呼了一句。接着，就看着美纳斯带着他在这个小小的蓄水池里面游来游去。“好了，好了，美纳斯，把我放下来。”双手抱住美纳斯的身躯，林枫有些无奈的道。虽然他能理解美纳斯的情绪。

但这样下去，他真的会湿身的好吗？“悠~~”悠长的鸣叫声响起，美纳斯似乎也意识到了这点，身躯有些平缓且颤抖的将林枫放了下来。“体型太大了，再住鱼缸有些不可能了，你就暂时住这里，看着这些种植物，有空就帮我浇一下水好吧。”“悠悠~！”美纳斯认真的点了点头。进化后，它能感觉到，自己的脑子灵光了很多，不像是以前，听林枫的一句话，要好久才能反应过来什么意思。“那就拜托你了~”林枫乐呵呵的道。“藤藤~？”旁边，目睹这一切的藤藤蛇脸上的惊讶根本遮掩不住。虽然它也知道宝可梦能进化。但像这样由丑到美最极致的升华，确实是生命最不可思议的存在。它应该也要快进化了吧？感受到最近时而躁动的能量，藤藤蛇突然有点憧憬起来了。“放心，你也快了...”林枫好似知道它的情绪一般，微笑着摸了摸它的头，不过心里面还是有些惆怅。进化的有点太快了。他还没抱过瘾呢~......翌日。7月12号。离宝宝杯开始还有两天。有了美纳斯在种植园中，林枫也就不用起早贪黑的监督杰尼龟浇水了。以美纳斯金色的天赋，将求雨技能光盘教给它后，只是顷刻之间，便已经融会贯通。能够在小区域内凝结空气中的水汽，进行灌溉。这也是他将杰尼龟放回去的原因。毕竟求雨都会了，这只憨憨龟就可以“退休”了。可惜的就是....
content_en:
Golden Qualification... Chou Chou Fish only had green qualification before. Lin Feng thought there would be a leap, but he didn't expect that the leap would be so big.It turned into a golden qualification directly."Yu~?" [Congratulations to the host for increasing Menas' happiness value from 70% to 98%. As a reward, he will receive 20 bags of golden garbage, an intermediate magical candy (increases the energy intensity to a medium extent), and a rain-seeking skill disc.] It happens to be at this moment.Menas also reacted to the afterglow after evolution and looked at his figure reflected on the water in disbelief.My mind is clearer than ever.Evolved?Every Ugly Fish knows that it can evolve into Menas.But it is clear how low the probability of the Ugly Fish evolving into Menas is.Most ugly fish may remain ugly fish throughout their lives... only a few may successfully evolve due to some kind of accident.This is as dreamy as a carp leaping over the dragon's gate.Therefore, Chou Chou Fish never thought that one day he would be able to evolve into Menas... He also thought that Lin Feng's words in the fish tank just now were to make it happy."Yuyou~!" (Evolved~!) "Yes, you have evolved!" After evolving into Menas, Lin Feng's Viridian Power was able to clearly understand the meaning of its words."Yuyou..." (So happy~!) Menas, who seemed a little too happy, couldn't help but wrap his tail around Lin Feng's body, as if he wanted to lift him up.The sudden feeling of weightlessness and the suffocating feeling like being wrapped around a python made Lin Feng shout out unaccustomedly.Then, he watched Menas lead him to swim around in this small reservoir."Okay, okay, Menas, put me down." Lin Feng said helplessly as he hugged Menas's body with both hands.Although he could understand Menas's emotions.

But if this continues, will he really get wet?"Yu~~" A long chirping sound sounded, and Menas seemed to realize this, and he put Lin Feng down gently and tremblingly."It's too big. It's impossible to live in a fish tank anymore. You can live here temporarily, look at these plants, and help me water them when you have time." "Yuyou~!" Menas nodded seriously.After evolving, it can feel that its brain is much brighter. Unlike before, it took a long time to understand what Lin Feng meant when hearing a sentence."Then I'll leave it to you~" Lin Feng said cheerfully."Teng Teng~?" Beside him, Teng Teng Snake who witnessed all this couldn't hide the surprise on his face.Although it also knows that Pokémon can evolve.But the ultimate sublimation from ugliness to beauty is indeed the most incredible existence in life.It should also evolve soon, right?Feeling the restless energy recently, Teng Teng Snake suddenly became a little longing for it."Don't worry, you're almost here..." Lin Feng seemed to know its mood, and smiled and touched its head, but he still felt a little melancholy in his heart.It evolved a little too fast.He hasn't had enough of hugging yet~...the next day.July 12th.There are still two days until the baby cup starts.With Menas in the plantation, Lin Feng no longer has to work from dawn to dusk to supervise Squirtle's watering.With Menas' golden talent, after teaching it the rain-seeking skill disc, it only took an instant to master it.It can condense water vapor in the air in a small area for irrigation.That's why he put Squirtle back.After all, if he knows how to pray for rain, this silly turtle can "retire".What a pity...
